answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can admit new keys only through liable sponsorship. An established member who vouches for a newcomer moves 300 of its own vested POA into a sponsor lagoon, a frozen sub-account held for 15 epochs. If random jurors find the newcomer tried to forge answers by copying or templating, the sponsor loses that lagoon and may not vouch for 30 epochs. Open vouches per sponsor have a zenith of two, so 100 fakes need 50 established members, each risking 600 POA. An honest newcomer needs one sponsor once. Weakness: vouches can be sold, but the cap limits that.
